name: Persistent Systems Ltd.
business_summary: Pune-based digital engineering and product-engineering services firm (BFSI, software/hi-tech, healthcare), with Salesforce, AWS and AI-led partnerships. Q2 FY27: revenue US$487.6 mn (+7.8% q/q, +20% y/y), Rs4,664 cr (+30%), EBIT margin 15.0% (-130 bp y/y on wage hikes, lower utilisation, deal amortisation), reported PAT Rs352 cr (-25%) after Rs185 cr of Nagarro deal costs; operating PAT Rs495 cr (+5%); TCV US$633.5 mn. Acquiring Nagarro SE (94.04% secured; squeeze-out planned), funded by a Rs4,265 cr QIP at Rs5,550 floor (allotted 26 Oct) and debt. Mcap Rs1.02 lakh cr, P/E 54.5.

revenue_mix.geography: North America ~75% / Europe ~12% / India ~10% / RoW ~3% (model estimate; Europe rises with Nagarro)

exposures.mechanism: ~90% of revenue USD, INR ~50% of costs (model knowledge); EBIT 15.0%: +3% INR => +95 bp = +6.3% EBIT; persistence 0.4, EV/MCap 1.05 => +2.6; trimmed for Nagarro's EUR revenue base. No significant empirical estimate.

evidence.note: ~90% of revenue USD (model knowledge); no significant empirical FX

exposures.mechanism: Mid-cap digital-engineering beta: growth is 2x TCS sensitivity to enterprise tech budgets. +5% spend => +4 pp cc growth; EBIT +6%; P/E 54.5 on growth => ~+5. Q2 US$487.6 mn (+20% y/y), TCV US$633 mn, deals slipped into Q3.

evidence.note: Revenue +7.8% q/q, +20% y/y; 26th straight sequential growth quarter
TCV US$633.5 mn, ACV US$481 mn

exposures.mechanism: Engineering/product-engineering services are more complementary to AI build-outs than BPS; +1 = ~3% repricing x 50% flow-through / 15% margin = -10% EBIT x persistence 0.4 => -4, offset by AI-native share gains => -3.

evidence.note: No formal guidance; AI-led engineering pipeline

exposures.mechanism: Large US onsite mix for a firm with ~US$2bn revenue; green-card freeze did not name Persistent, but a broad H-1B rule change would hit; -2.5.

evidence.note: US green-card freeze (named firms exclude Persistent)

exposures.mechanism: Empirical +2.15 per +5% S&P (t=2.3): the AI trade and US tech sentiment; kept near empirical.
Empirical -1.17 per +5 VIX (t=-2.3), consistent with a high-multiple mid-cap.
